text:
**Best practical pick: BLUETTI AC180 + 200W solar panel kit.** It’s specifically singled out as a home-backup pick, and the listed kit price is **$729**; the deal listing also mentions a discount code. ([WPA-Pool roundup](https://www.wpa-pool.com/best-solar-generators-under-1000/), [kit deal](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit))

If you can wait for a preorder, the **ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400W panel kit** is a stronger panel bundle for **$698**: the listing gives it a 1kWh LiFePO₄ battery, an 1,800W inverter, and says it ships Dec. 7. ([Kit details and purchase link](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit))

Either is for **essential backup**, not running a whole house; check the current price and availability before ordering.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit

judge.why: The top pick is our BLUETTI AC180 kit, and its price comes from the dealectric.com link, with a third-party roundup cited only for the home-backup claim.
